items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I have to be in the mood or someone has to remind me of something to spur that on... watching Les Paul be the road... he was always good to me... sometimes he’d get mad because I went on the road. I couldn’t be there every Monday night for ten years

ctx.x: Because what happens with that, it’s like saying an Australian expression. I have to be in the mood or someone has to remind me of something to spur that on and it’s hard to do that. There were really funny times watching Les Paul be the road. Now here he’s like 90 years old and he’s going out to California and just to watch him around the celebrities and people that came to the gig and just to see how he handled it, and then if there was a problem with the money and watching him just stand backstage and not go…
I guess you can learn from all those things, but it seems like he didn’t suffer fools gladly.
